title: THE ULTIMATE 5 DAYS CUTTING-STRENGHT PROGRAM
desc:
Build strength. Build muscle. Make every rep count.

Purpose: A 10-week, five-day Upper/Lower + Push/Pull/Legs program designed to build strength and muscle through progressive overload, controlled effort and consistent recovery. Each session fits within 80 minutes, with clear targets for tracking your progress.

ex.note: Smith low-incline press: Use a comfortable 15-30 degree incline. Set the bench and safeties before loading. Alternative: Incline dumbbell press. 3min rest
Chest-supported row: Keep chest on the pad and elbows moderately out; avoid shrugging. Alternative: Seated cable row. 2.5min rest
Neutral-grip lat pulldown: Drive elbows down with a comfortable overhead reach; avoid swinging. Alternative: Medium-grip lat pulldown. 2min rest
Converging chest press: Set handles near mid-chest; use a repeatable, comfortable depth. Alternative: Machine chest press. 2min rest
Single-arm cable lateral raise: Keep torso still. Match the weaker side; finish both sides before the full rest. Alternative: Dumbbell lateral raise. 1.5min rest
Reverse pec deck: Move upper arms outward without shrugging; keep chest supported. Alternative: Cable rear-delt fly. 1.5min rest

Bayesian cable curl: Set cable low and stand slightly forward so upper arm rests behind torso. Curl without moving the shoulder; usea
comfortable stretch. Complete both sides before full rest. 1.5min
Cable triceps pressdown: Keep upper arms still and complete a comfortable elbow extension. Alternative: Rope triceps pressdown.

Cable crunch: Curl ribs toward pelvis rather than hinging at the hips. Keep at least 2 RIR so you can still brace well for hack squats and RDLs.
Alternative: Machine abdominal crunch. 1.5min rest
Hack squat: Use the deepest controlled, comfortable range. Set the machine stops. Alternative: Smith squat with safeties. 3min rest

Romanian deadlift: Soft knees, hips back, load close. Stop before your back position changes. Always retain at least 2 RIR. 
3min rest

Seated leg curl: Align knees with the pivot; secure hips and control the return. Alternative: Lying leg curl.
1.5min rest

Leg extension: Align knees with the pivot; extend smoothly without kicking. Alternative: Single-leg press.
1.5min rest

Standing calf raise: Keep knees nearly straight; pause at top and bottom without bouncing. Alternative: Leg-press calf raise.
1.5min rest

Seated hip abduction: Sit with pelvis stable. Push knees outward smoothly, pause, then return under control; do not rock your torso.
Alternative: Standing cable hip abduction.
1.5min rest
ncline dumbbell press: Use a comfortable 15-30 degree incline and stable base; lower under control. Alternative: Incline machine press. 3min rest

Smith flat bench press: Set bench and safeties first; choose a comfortable touch point. Alternative: Machine chest press.
2.5min rest

Seated machine shoulder press: Set handles around shoulder level. Keep back supported and ribs down; press overhead through a
comfortable range. Add one or two easy ramp sets. 2min rest

High-to-low cable fly: Set pulleys above shoulder height. With softly bent elbows, sweep arms down and inward toward your lower chest or
upper abdomen; do not turn it into a triceps pressdown. 1.5min

Cable lateral raise: Use a single-arm setup; match the weaker side and finish both sides before full rest. Alternative: Dumbbell lateral raise.
1.5min rest

Overhead cable triceps extension: Keep ribs stacked and upper arms steady; use a comfortable overhead stretch. Alternative: Cable triceps
pressdown.
1.5min rest

Neutral-grip lat pulldown: Keep torso angle consistent; pull toward upper chest without excessive lean. Alternative: Medium-grip lat pulldown.
2min rest
Chest-supported row: Reach under control, then row with chest on the pad; preserve your lower back. Alternative: Seated cable row. 2.5min rest
Reverse pec deck: Move through the shoulders without turning the set into a shrug. Alternative: Cable rear-delt fly.1.5min rest
Machine shrug: Elevate shoulders, pause, then lower. Do not roll shoulders. Alternative: Smith shrug or dumbbell shrug. 1.5min rest
Preacher curl: Keep upper arms supported; approach elbow extension without bouncing. 1.5min rest
Preacher curl: Keep upper arms supported; approach elbow extension without bouncing. 1.5min rest

Captain's-chair leg raise: Support forearms on the pads. Raise legs under control and gently curl pelvis upward; avoid swinging. Bend knees
if needed and keep at least 2 RIR.
1.5min rest
Leg press: Use a comfortable stance and depth without your pelvis rolling off the pad. 3min rest
Smith machine split squat: Use a staggered stance with rear toes on the floor; set safeties. Lower under control. 2min rest
Seated leg curl: Keep hips down and control the lengthened position. 1.5min rest
Leg extension: Smooth reps with a controlled finish; no kicking into lockout. 1.5min rest

Seated hip adduction: Set a comfortable starting width. Bring knees inward smoothly, pause, then return under control without forcing the
stretch. 1.5min rest
